title: perf(i18n, console)!: the Developer pages' and Connect an AI assistant strings load on demand, off the eager English pack
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQpNH669Kx1m7Ee7gTKTkq7)_

Fixes #32225

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「开发者」四个页面（API 控制台、流程运行、公开表单、集成与 API）、「连接 AI 助手」页面和用户记录的「AI 助手」页签所用的 `console.developer.*`、`connectAgent.*` 两组文案，从 11 种语言的语言包里整块剪出，放进新的懒加载命名空间 `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/developer`，打开这些界面时才下载；marketplace 命名空间与它共用一个新的加载器 `createPackNamespace`。
- 为什么改：每次首屏都要下载的 `i18n-locale-en` 已顶到 60.5 KB 上限（61,881 / 62,000 B），新增英文键的 PR（#32050、#32172、#32124、#32184、#32195）在合并队列里因 `check:eager-closure` 被弹出；现在是 57,330 B，留出 4,670 B 余量，上限一个字节没动。
- 风险与回滚：文案一个字没改，每种语言仍然完整（`@object-ui/i18n/locales` 合并了所有命名空间）；读这些键的组件都包在 `DeveloperNamespaceGate` 里，未加载时显示骨架屏，加载失败显示「出错了 / 重试」，绝不显示英文或原始键名。导出的 `en` / `TranslationKeys` 少了这两组键（BREAKING，见 changeset），回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/packNamespace.ts`（从 marketplace 抽出的通用加载器）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/developer/index.ts`（新命名空间）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/DeveloperNamespaceGate.tsx`（加载框）、`ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`（11 个 `i18n-ns-developer-*` 分块）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/developer-namespace.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/DeveloperNamespaceGate-32225.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/developer/IntegrationsPage.developerNamespace-32225.test.tsx`，预期全绿；`pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` 显示 `i18n-locale-en 56.0 KB / 60.5 KB`。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 共 8,041 行，超过 3,000 行人工合并线（不涉及受管路径），请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 任一人 Approve；批准后席位转 ready 入合并队列，或由维护者直接合并。

## What changes

- **A second pack-shaped lazy namespace, `developer`.** `console.developer.*` (the four Developer pages) and `connectAgent.*` (the Connect an AI Assistant widget and the AI Assistants tab of a `sys_user` record) are cut whole from all eleven language packs into `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/developer/<tag>.ts`, one literal `() => import()` per platform locale tag, exactly the shape of `marketplace` (#30588 / #30640). `zh-Hant.ts` is generated from `zh-Hans.ts` (`gen:zh-hant`, registered in `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`). Call sites are unchanged: they still call `t('console.developer.…')` / `t('connectAgent.…')` on the default namespace, and the catalogues deep-merge into the page's instance.
- **One loader for both namespaces.** The marketplace index's runtime (language resolution, the two-catalogue wait, the resident short-circuit under `registerBuiltInLocales()`, the silent `addResourceBundle`, retry) moved verbatim into `namespaces/packNamespace.ts` as `createPackNamespace({ name, groups, probeKey, loaders })`. The resident check now reads any dotted group path, not only a top-level key. `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/marketplace` exports the same names as before.
- **A frame on every reader.** `DeveloperNamespaceGate` (app-shell, exported) renders children once the namespace answers `ready`, a copy-free skeleton while it loads, and the console's resident "Something went wrong / Try again" when a catalogue cannot be fetched. The four Developer pages, `ConnectAgent` and `ManagedPersonAssistants` render their bodies inside it. `PACK_NAMESPACE_FRAMES` in `ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` now lists the developer namespace's two frame directories, so a namespace-only key read anywhere else is refused (class 9).
- **Chunks.** Eleven `i18n-ns-developer-<tag>` groups (priority 84) in `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`. The loader module stays in `i18n-runtime` on purpose: app-shell registers the connect widgets eagerly.
- **The complete door.** `@object-ui/i18n/locales` merges each pack with its marketplace and developer catalogues, so key parity, `registerBuiltInLocales()` and every test that reads a complete language still see every key.
- **Budget note, ceiling unchanged.** A dated reading above `'i18n-locale-en': 62_000` in `ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`. ⛔ The ceiling and its baseline are not moved.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/32225-developer-lazy-namespace.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch and `@object-ui/console` patch, with the declaration lines and an ADR-0087 not-required marker (runtime-interface-only `TranslationKeys`, the #30640 precedent). `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and gets no row.

`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, measured: the package entry's `en`, the exported `TranslationKeys` and the pack modules `@object-ui/i18n/locales/<code>` lose the two groups. The claim line said `no`; this is the same narrowing #30640 declared for marketplace.

### Readings (`ui/apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, `CI=true vite build`)

| | `main` dee2e920 | this branch | change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `i18n-locale-en` gzip | 61,881 B | 57,330 B | −4,551 B |
| headroom under the 62,000 B ceiling | 119 B | 4,670 B | |
| eager closure gzip | 2,267,784 B | 2,264,606 B | −3,178 B |
| `i18n-runtime` gzip | 7,913 B | 8,997 B | +1,084 B |
| `src` gzip | 66,844 B | 67,111 B | +267 B |
| eager chunks | 105 | 105 | |

The branch reading of `i18n-locale-en` is unchanged after merging `main` e1146e80 (57,330 B, closure 2,264,584 B). `i18n-runtime` grows by the shared loader plus the developer loader; `src` by the frame.

## Tests

- `developer-namespace.test.ts` (new): lazy by construction (one literal `import()` per catalogue, one catalogue per built-in language, no static catalogue import, built on `packNamespace.js`), cut and not copied (each catalogue holds the two groups only, no pack holds either, the packs' other `console` groups stay), the complete door (every language carries pack and namespace keys; the entry's `en` is the resident pack alone), and the loader (refuses an unshipped code; loads a catalogue once and answers the same object after). Key parity across languages stays `all-locales-key-parity`'s.
- `DeveloperNamespaceGate-32225.test.tsx` (new): zh-CN `ConnectAgent` shows the skeleton, then Chinese, never English or a raw key; ja `ManagedPersonAssistants` the same; a page that does not read the namespace fetches no developer chunk; ar fetch failure shows the resident error and Try again recovers.
- `IntegrationsPage.developerNamespace-32225.test.tsx` (new): zh-CN cold mount, skeleton, then Chinese.
- Existing suites held to two namespaces: `marketplace-namespace.test.ts`, `zh-hant-generated.test.ts`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts`.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): drop the namespace registration (`addResourceBundle` in `packNamespace.ts`) → red; let the gate render children while loading → red. Both restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

<details><summary>Test and gate log</summary>

- vitest (`cd ui`): `packages/i18n/`, app-shell `console/connect/` and `marketplace/`, console `pages/developer/`, three `ui/scripts` suites: 188 files, 3028 passed, 16 failed on the first run; the 4 files holding them fixed and re-run 143/143 green.
- type-check: `@object-ui/i18n` (both tsconfigs), `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`: exit 0. eslint on touched files: 0 errors.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`: exit 0 (`i18n-locale-en 56.0 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling, headroom 4.6 KB`).
- `check-i18n-call-site-keys`: exit 0, the developer namespace read 255 times, all inside its frames. `check-i18n-en-drift`: exit 0, 0 keys removed. `check-i18n-dead-keys`: report identical to `main` dee2e920 apart from walked-file counts (the three `connectAgent.capabilities.example*` needs-review rows are on `main` too).
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at 7b1de06c: 76 derived, 76 run, all exit 0 (`check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 1 / 3 for missing dists, re-run 0 after a full `pnpm build`, 119/119 tasks); `--ran`: 76 accounted, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- dogfood (title carries `!`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock at 7b1de06c after the full build: 446 files passed, 3 skipped; 3712 tests passed, 42 skipped; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Head 04e5c1ec merges `main` bb67b987 (no `ui/` change beyond `ui/packages/auth`, no `en` key change): the four namespace and frame test files re-run 109/109, `check-i18n-call-site-keys` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Five merge-queue ejections at `i18n-locale-en`: the chunk is now 57,330 B against 62,000 B, 4,670 B of headroom, without moving the ceiling or the baseline.
- Every locale moved with the subtree; no string text changed.
- No first-load surface reads the moved keys: a cold load of `/home` fetches no `i18n-ns-developer-*` chunk.

## Verification

Production preview build of this branch (`vite preview`) over a showcase dev boot, admin sign-in, en-US and zh-CN, each surface opened from a cold load in a fresh context:

| surface | en | zh-CN |
|---|---|---|
| `/home` | no developer chunk | no developer chunk |
| Developer › Integrations, API console, Flow runs, Public forms | `i18n-ns-developer-en` | `i18n-ns-developer-zh-Hans` + `-en` |
| Account › Connect an AI Assistant | `i18n-ns-developer-en` | `i18n-ns-developer-zh-Hans` + `-en` |
| Setup › Users › a user › AI Assistants tab | `i18n-ns-developer-en` | `i18n-ns-developer-zh-Hans` + `-en` |

No raw `console.developer.*` / `connectAgent.*` key text on any page, no failed frame, no skeleton left after load; the zh-CN pages read in Chinese (for example 「集成与 API」, 「连接 AI 智能体（MCP）」, 「已授权的 AI 助手」). Shots: project folder `ui-orders/32225-shots/` (14 files).

<details><summary>Browser harness notes</summary>

The console builds with a relative `base` (`./`), which the preview server does not rewrite for deep links, so the harness mapped `/apps/…/assets/*` requests to `/assets/*`; the chunk names in the table are the requested file names. The "Agent key" default in the API-key name box is a hard-coded initial value in `AgentConnectSection.tsx` on `main`, not a key of this namespace.

</details>
